edition: Nestle-Aland 28 (NA28); German Bible Society online running text
authorization: User explicitly authorized NA28 provisionally on 15 October 2026; UBS6/ECM review remains pending.
scope: NA28 is the user-authorized provisional New Testament base. Focused checks of the German Bible Society’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not complete critical-text or apparatus verification. The newer Bespoke PDF’s preferred UBS6 text has not been obtained; UBS6/ECM comparison, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
historical_records: Existing index and reference records were consulted as historical reference, not proof of fresh complete Greek verification.

chapters.decision: Preserved the repeated gospel, grace, human/divine contrast, ages, flesh and blood, womb and named itinerary. Corrected 1:3 from inherited God the Father and our Lord to God our Father and the Lord, following displayed NA28. Included bracketed God at 1:15; retained bracketed Christ at 1:6 and to you at 1:8. Smoothed persecution and recognition clauses; preserved three years and fifteen days.

chapters.decision: Preserved the running, slavery/freedom, pillars, face-to-face, rebuilding and crucifixion images, all works/law/faith repetitions and negations. Modernized does, smoothed the topic opening in 2:6 and rendered plural right hands in 2:9. Included bracketed also at 2:13. Kept the inherited provisional faith in Christ and faith in the Son of God readings; Christ’s faithfulness remains a live interpretive alternative. Retained the existing quotation boundaries and placement of crucified with Christ at 2:19.

chapters.decision: Preserved every law/faith/promise repetition, hearing with faith, curse/tree, the seed/seeds argument and four hundred and thirty years.
